lines.say: It's Nihon, or Nippon. Written sun and origin: where the sun rises.
China is Zhongguo. The middle kingdom.
Korea comes from Goryeo, an old dynasty. South Korea calls itself Hanguk.
India's constitution says it in Article 1: India, that is Bharat.
Sri Lanka was Ceylon until 1972. Sri Lanka means: resplendent island.
Bhutan is Druk Yul. The land of the thunder dragon.
In English, Thailand was Siam until 1939. At home, it's Prathet Thai.
Georgia is Sakartvelo, land of the Kartvelians.
And Armenia is Hayastan, land of the Hay.
Which name should English switch to?
Parts 1 and 2 are on my profile. And remember:

caption_en:
India's constitution answers this in its very first article.

What countries in Asia call themselves:
Japan: Nihon / Nippon (日本), written "sun" + "origin"
China: Zhōngguó (中国), "the middle kingdom"
South Korea: Hanguk (한국); "Korea" comes from Goryeo, an old Korean dynasty
Mongolia: Mongol Uls (Монгол Улс)
India: Bhārat (भारत). Article 1 of the Constitution: "India, that is Bharat, shall be a Union of States."
Sri Lanka: Sri Lankā (ශ්‍රී ලංකාව), "resplendent island"; officially Ceylon until 1972
Bhutan: Druk Yul (འབྲུག་ཡུལ།), "land of the thunder dragon"
Thailand: Prathet Thai (ประเทศไทย); known in English as Siam until 1939
Cambodia: Kampuchea (កម្ពុជា)
Georgia: Sakartvelo (საქართველო), "land of the Kartvelians"
Armenia: Hayastan (Հայաստան), from Hay, the Armenians' name for themselves

Two names, one place. Both are real.
Parts 1 (Europe) and 2 (Middle East and Africa) on my profile.

Sources: Wikipedia, List of countries and dependencies and their capitals in native languages; Names of Japan; Names of China; Names of Korea; Sri Lanka; Bhutan; Thailand (2026). Constitution of India, Article 1.

caption_he:
החוקה של הודו עונה על זה כבר בסעיף הראשון.

יפן היא ניהון ("מקור השמש"), סין היא ג'ונגגואו ("ממלכת האמצע"), דרום קוריאה היא הנגוק, מונגוליה היא מונגול אולס, סרי לנקה (עד 1972 ציילון) פירושה "האי הזוהר", בהוטן היא דרוק יול ("ארץ דרקון הרעם"), הודו היא גם בהרט (סעיף 1 בחוקה), תאילנד היא פראטט תאי (באנגלית: סיאם עד 1939), קמבודיה היא קמפוצ'יה, גאורגיה היא סקרטוולו וארמניה היא הייסטן.
חלקים 1 ו-2 בפרופיל.
